Notes: Lines Alucia (the guide) says. Edit the Text column freely.
They are IDs the game matches on. Only edit Text / Mood / Weight.
Copy a row and change its Text. The game picks one at random so she doesn't repeat.
Blank = any fish. A name = only when THAT fish triggers it. Must match the game's species name exactly.
Calm / Warn / Win -> tints her speech bubble. Nothing else is allowed.
Optional number. Higher = shown more often. Blank = 1.
{species}=fish name, {req}=what's still needed, {count}=how many. The game fills them in.

intro.1/2/3, health.critical, health.unstable.up, health.unstable.down, health.healthy, health.thriving, notify.unlocked, hint.withReq.1-4, hint.fallback, species.overpopulated, species.overpredated, species.starving, species.extinct, species.added
overpopulated = too many, add a predator. overpredated = too many predators, remove one. starving = no food, add its prey.
